", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u007-r0069", "tag": "p", "text": "“Greetings, camarada,” Francis said. “We’ll have you out of here in a jiffy.” He held up two sticks of dynamite, with fuse and caps complete. “I have brought this pretty crowbar to pry you out. And the [[I]]Angelique[[/I]] is right off the beach waiting for you.—Now, stand back. I’m going to touch her off. ", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u007-r0073", "tag": "p", "text": "“Senor Morgan, you are about to take up your rightful abode in hell.”", "sha256": "508bfff9271cc6e94b0f972415ce1f6303fefb5b3db72f148ad100dc4f2a62ce", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[557]", "source_html": "
